svg.text: Loop: where Top 6 concentrate a ship or habit more than the Rest
Each dot is the centre of one laid smoke, team-normalized (north-spawn teams mirrored north-south). Outline = the spot (solid = signature, dashed = lead).
Signature: cap sitters, own-side and east half of cap B
2nd destroyer: position recorded 15 of 15, forward of the smoke 8 (Marceau 6).
Lead: Gdańsk, own-side rim of cap B
2nd destroyer: position recorded 8 of 8, forward of the smoke 4 (20 de Julio 2).
